title: PROLOGUE: THE LINE
summary: Vesper introduces itself through the language of order: HALO, Eclipse, Hero, Villain. The line appears absolute only because nobody has yet looked closely at the person standing on the other side.
signatureLine: No line stays simple once you know the face on the other side.

title: FIRST CONTACT
summary: Taeyun meets the man he has spent months studying. When Jiwon sacrifices a perfect tactical position to protect a civilian, the file in Taeyun's head stops matching the man in front of him.
signatureLine: Maybe the file left something out.

title: SECOND LOOK
summary: Jiwon replays the encounter because one detail refuses to fit: Taeyun had the opening and chose not to take it. The certainty Jiwon relies on begins with a question he cannot dismiss.
signatureLine: You had the opening. Why didn't you take it?

title: NO SAINT
summary: Taeyun refuses the comfort of innocence. He names the compromises, damage and choices behind the Architect while admitting that Jiwon began as something useful: a key to the truth buried inside HALO.

title: HOLD THE LINE
summary: Jiwon attempts to turn fixation into procedure. Instead, his attention narrows to Taeyun's voice, hands and contradictions, while the boundary he insists he understands becomes harder to defend.
signatureLine: I know exactly where the line is.

title: CROSSFIRE
summary: Taeyun engineers their second encounter. What begins as provocation becomes physical confrontation when Jiwon disarms him and the distance between threat and attraction suddenly disappears.
signatureLine: Funny. You're standing on my side of the line.

title: AFTER CURFEW
summary: Jiwon goes to the Observatory without orders. Neutral ground turns ideological curiosity into something personal: Taeyun reveals his former HALO life, Jiwon removes one glove, and neither man crosses the final distance.

title: UNARMED
summary: Injured and pulled into a Blackout memory, Taeyun lets Jiwon see him without performance. Jiwon treats the wound with bare hands, and when Taeyun stops before taking the kiss, Jiwon chooses it himself.
signatureLine: Because this one can't belong to the plan.

title: OFF THE RECORD
summary: Weeks of stolen time turn the Observatory into a lived-in place: coffee, messages, sleep, familiar touch and weapons left farther away. Aegis belongs to daylight; here, Jiwon begins to exist without the role.

title: OFF SCRIPT
summary: A mundane moment tells Taeyun what danger never could: Jiwon has become real to him. The plan is no longer the problem; the truth Taeyun still has not surrendered is.
signatureLine: And that's the worst lie I've told you yet.

title: FAULT LINE
summary: Jiwon finds the dossier: psychological profiling, biometric access, Seojun and the architecture of Taeyun's original plan. The betrayal is not that every feeling was false, but that Taeyun decided which truths Jiwon was allowed to have.

title: DON'T COME BACK
summary: Taeyun does not chase Jiwon. He deletes routes, removes him from the Core plan and opens every file, including the evidence against himself. He sends no argument for love—only the archive and the right to decide.

title: THE LINE — REPRISE
summary: Jiwon verifies the archive independently, tries the system from within and watches HALO refuse its own evidence. He reclaims Aegis as a shield chosen by him, returns to Taeyun by choice and refuses every hierarchy offered to him.

title: WHEN HALOS BURN
summary: Side by side inside Halo Core, Jiwon and Taeyun release the complete archive. When Taeyun slips back into control disguised as protection, Jiwon draws the final boundary: love does not cancel agency.
signatureLine: I love you. That doesn't mean you get to choose for me.

title: AFTERLIGHT
summary: The truth does not repair Vesper overnight. Investigations begin, reputations fracture and accountability remains complicated. Jiwon and Taeyun leave the city temporarily with no uniform, no coat and no roles left between their names.
